focus: Only the root tangle core: TUBAD_TangleCore invisible edifice def, spawn order in GenStep_DungeonLayout divider loop, Plant_RootTangle.DeSpawn destroying the core. Does it block fog/LOS, does cutting still work, any error from drawerType None / destroy.
diffSource: since build 27 (2026-10-10T01:12:24Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Possible one-off 'already destroyed' error if something wipes a live tangle cell
findings.detail: GenSpawn.WipeExistingThings takes a copy of the cell's things and calls Destroy on each one without checking Destroyed. If anything later spawns something that wipes both the tangle plant and the core edifice onto that cell (another mod, a skyfaller or a later map-gen step), and the plant comes first in the copy, Plant_RootTangle.DeSpawn destroys the core and the loop then destroys the core again, which logs one error. It needs another mod or event to spawn onto that cell, and I did not confirm which of the two comes first in the cell's list. If it matters, make DeSpawn leave the core alone when it is not the reason the plant is going.

findings.title: Root tangles in build-27 saves load as plain Plant without a core
findings.detail: From memory of how the game saves things (not checked here): existing tangles were saved as a plain Plant, so on load they stay plain Plants and have no TUBAD_TangleCore. Behind them the fog behaves as it did in build 27. Nothing errors, and dungeon maps are temporary, so nothing needs doing.

checked: Fog: FloodFillerFog stops at full-wall edifices, and fillPercent 1 makes the core one (ThingDef.cs:623)
Unfog on removal: Building.DeSpawn calls Notify_FogBlockerRemoved when the core is destroyed rather than replaced (Building.cs:208-211, FogGrid.cs:121-144)
Spawn order: a spawned plant never wipes anything, and the core spawned second would have wiped the plant, so core-first is right (GenSpawn.SpawningWipes)
Cutting: plant designators, WorkGiver_PlantsCut and JobDriver_PlantWork do not look at the cell's edifice
Chop and cut: the def sets no chopped/burned/smashed stump, so TrySpawnStump spawns nothing into the cell (Plant.cs:666-704); PlantCollected then destroys the plant, whose DeSpawn removes the core
Burning: ChanceToStartFireIn's impassable-edifice check uses ContractedBy(1), empty for 1x1 (FireUtility.cs:62-63); Fire.DoComplexCalcs damages the plant by its flammability
drawerType None: the draw paths skip it (SectionLayer_Things.cs:66, DynamicDrawManager.cs:160/172); graphic resolution with the texture present is harmless
Core def <building> fields exist in BuildingProperties (isInert, isTargetable, claimable, destroyShakeAmount, deconstructible as a private field XML can set)
Flammability 0 with useHitPoints false does not trip the ThingDef.cs:1844 config check
Plant_RootTangle.DeSpawn saves Map and Position before base.DeSpawn and guards null map / already-destroyed core
[StaticConstructorOnStartup] on DungeonSite is correct: static readonly MaterialPropertyBlock at DungeonSite.cs:60
DungeonDefOf.TUBAD_TangleCore matches the defName in Defs/TUBAD_Dungeon.xml
